doc.brief: Preserves the aspect ratio of its child.
doc.md:
Preserves the aspect ratio of its child.

The frame can respect the aspect ratio of the child widget,
or use its own aspect ratio.

# CSS nodes

`GtkAspectFrame` uses a CSS node with name `aspectframe`.

# Accessibility

Until GTK 4.10, `GtkAspectFrame` used the [`AccessibleRole.group`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:group) role.

Starting from GTK 4.12, `GtkAspectFrame` uses the [`AccessibleRole.generic`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:generic) role.
